FISHING LICENCE · SPAIN

Spain fishing licence

The autonomous communities issue fishing licences, with separate freshwater and sea systems. A freshwater licence does not replace a reserved-water permit, and an interregional licence covers only participating communities.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Freshwater anglers need the applicable regional or interregional licence.
  • Marine anglers need the regional licence for their method; some species also require national authorisation.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Interregional freshwater licenceany1 yearEUR 25

Extra stamps and permits

  • Reserved-water permit
    For controlled fishing grounds, such as Castilla y Leon cotos, in addition to the basic licence.
  • Special marine-species authorisation
    For boat fishing targeting species covered by the ministry's special authorisation scheme.

Saltwater

Coastal communities issue shore, boat and underwater licences. The ministry also administers special-species authorisations and the PescaREC declaration system.

Rules visitors should know

  • Check that the licence covers your autonomous community.
  • Obtain the permit for a reserved freshwater fishing ground.
  • Declare the required marine catches, including releases, in PescaREC within 24 hours after the fishing activity.
  • The interregional licence covers Andalusia, Aragon, Castilla-La Mancha, Castilla y Leon, Madrid, Valencia, Extremadura, Galicia, Asturias and Murcia.

How to buy

Apply through the chosen autonomous community's official licence service. Obtain reserved-water permits through its separate allocation or sales system.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Spain?

The autonomous communities issue fishing licences, with separate freshwater and sea systems. A freshwater licence does not replace a reserved-water permit, and an interregional licence covers only participating communities.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Spain?

Interregional freshwater licence: EUR 25 (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Spain?

Apply through the chosen autonomous community's official licence service. Obtain reserved-water permits through its separate allocation or sales system.
